title: Santa Fe Soup
description: This Santa Fe soup recipe combines browned ground beef with processed cheese, tomatoes, corn kernels, and canned ranch-style beans for easy comfort.
ingredients: 1 pound processed cheese food (eg. Velveeta), cubed
1 (14.5 ounce) can peeled and diced tomatoes
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers

steps.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir ground beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease.

Combine browned beef, tomatoes with liquid, stewed tomatoes with chilies, corn with liquid, Ranch-style beans with liquid, cubed processed cheese, and onion in a large pot. Simmer on low heat until cheese is melted and the onion is tender. Serve hot.
